dependsOn: real pinned EveJS overlay + native NPC mining
real warehouse itemStore and two authorized clients

scenarios.title: Actual miner target and ore cargo attachment
steps: Spawn authorized native mining fleet in disposable Perimeter 30000144
Record a real mining controller target and cargo quantity growth at the same miner itemID
Read nativeNpcStore cargo rather than virtual mining ledger
expected: No positive mining result without a real controller and quantity delta
No E2E PASS from state=MINING alone

scenarios.title: Haul transfers exactly one native cargo identity
steps: Make miner hold a physically recorded positive ore cargoID
Allow normal native mining fleet cargo transfer to durable hauler
Compare miner and hauler nativeNpcStore rows and owner/system
expected: Identical cargoID moves from one physical ship to one physical ship
No duplicated original stack remains on miner

scenarios.title: Durable full manifest precedes accepted warp
steps: Enable native full haul manifest on a disposable overlay
Load at least two actual ore stacks with distinct IDs
Observe manifest fsync before first accepted warp
Verify exact manifest IDs and native route station
expected: No warp on PREPARE uncertainty or missing cargo
No anonymous or synthetic cargo rows
requiredEvidence: fsynced manifest filename and raw cargoIDs

scenarios.title: Physical station arrival, dwell, warehouse COMMITTED and itemStore credit
steps: Warp named fleet to real in-scene native station
Verify actual surface distance, ship state and dwell time
Inspect each warehouse source debit receipt and itemStore unique tagged item
Read ALIFE native delivery evidence only after full manifest verified
expected: Each source cargo debited exactly once and only one native itemStore destination item appears
Stable eventID includes full manifest, carries physical cargoIDs and never awards ISK

scenarios.title: Last cargo committed but terminal in-memory state missing
steps: Prepare genuine two-stack manifest and settle its final native warehouse receipt
Drop only in-memory delivery completedStackCount or simulated tick acknowledgment
Run next normal arrival tick with empty hauler and full original manifest
Repeat tick once more
expected: Already-committed cargo is never debited/granted twice
Recovered delivery comes from full manifest, not empty cargo assumption
One full manifest evidence and dedup key
requiredEvidence: source cargo absent with same cargoID
warehouse COMMITTED and native itemStore identities

scenarios.title: Crash after native cargo debit before warehouse item credit
steps: Use disposable fault injection to lose native itemStore grant response after source removal
Restart local server preserving receipts and SQLite state
Read warehouse pending/outcome-unknown status and attempt ordinary retry
expected: No automatic second grant, no phantom item, pending receipt stays operator repair required
No ALIFE settlement success event when manifest incomplete
requiredEvidence: source cargo row and unique tag

scenarios.title: Cross-fleet cargo replay and station owner spoof
steps: Attempt reusing existing cargoID in new native fleet manifest
Attempt mismatched station corporation/system and forged or incomplete manifest
Audit copied ALIFE event JSONL with read-only CLI
expected: Conflicting cargoID and native receipt identities cannot prove settlement
No native transfer, wallet credit or reward from audit
requiredEvidence: full source and target owner/cargo identity
conflict audit report and immutable manifests

scenarios.title: Two-client visual proof and missing native station fail closed
steps: Connect two authorized EVE co-op clients in the disposable system
Observe actual hauler trip and native warehouse success event with common fleetID
Remove or invalidate station native scene proof on a separate test run
expected: Both clients observe the same real ship and station arrival, not synthetic teleport
Invalid station or ship cannot produce delivery or A-Life SETTLE
requiredEvidence: native controller orders and warehouse/manifest records
